feedback: Frank’s confession follows the previously available chain: the front existed in design but was omitted in installation, the exposed bottle supplied cyanide, and his admitted private-place visit offered access to the waiting glass. His reaching the bottle and administering poison are newly explicit admissions, but they confirm inferred actions rather than introduce a new clue needed to identify him. The drawing-versus-room metaphor connects naturally to his career and safety dispute, giving the lie emotional meaning. Chip and Barb’s consequential admissions keep their earlier misconduct significant even after acquittal. The resolution feels earned and reasonably satisfying, although Frank’s concise explanatory confession is somewhat cleaner than a person under arrest might sound.
